name: B10-0251/2026 (ESN) – Situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on the Taliban's new criminal procedure rules for courts and on the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan. It asks the European Union to change its approach, to push the Taliban towards reforms that improve women's and girls' rights and education, and to talk to the Taliban about organised returns of Afghans. It also criticises a 2024 court ruling that lets Afghan women get asylum based on gender and nationality alone.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only sets out its position and requests.
- It affects Afghan women and girls, Afghans facing return, and European Union asylum policy.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and member state governments.
